model_io.model: GEANT4 Monte Carlo transport
inputs: protons, deuterons, 3He particles with specified energies; 133Cs, 127Xe, 127I targets

model_io.model: TALYS/EMPIRE nuclear reaction codes
inputs: reaction type, beam energy, target nucleus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined GEANT4, SRIM, TALYS, and EMPIRE codes provide reliable nuclear reaction predictions before experimental implementation
hypotheses.result: Good compatibility observed between experimental and simulated cross-sections and production yields
